column2: Afterwards one should transfer the subtle body, stationed in the Self and previously purified, and contemplate it grown in order, with the senses distinctly arranged.
Then, having stayed one year in the egg and divided it in two — heaven and earth as the two halves — in the middle of them, Prajapati
having meditated as born, again sprinkling, joined with Om, making the body made of mantra with placement as stated before,
then Vishnu, having placed his hand on the head and meditating on the Vaishnava; thus, by meditation-yoga, having produced one or many,
taking the hands with the root-mantra and binding the eyes with a cloth, the mantra-master with the eye-mantra to them with the house, unstruck,
the teacher, having worshipped well the god of gods, knowing the truth, should seat the disciples, holding flower-handfuls, facing east.
And they, thus born from the teacher, should worship Hari; having thrown the flower-handful there, then with flowers and the rest,
having done the worship without mantra, then the worship of the teacher's feet, having done so, one should give a fee — all one's possessions or half.
The teacher should instruct the disciples; Hari is to be worshipped by them with his names. One should worship Vishvaksena, the lord, bearer of conch, discus and mace.
Repeating that with the forefinger, one should dismiss him who stands in the mandala.
All Vishnu's remnants of offering should be offered to Vishvaksena; having sprinkled oneself with the Pranita waters, and the one at the fire-pit,
having joined the fire to oneself, one should dismiss Vishvaksena. The seeker of enjoyment gains everything; the seeker of liberation dissolves in Hari.
Having placed the pervading mental placement, then in order beginning with the thumb; the head, face, heart, secret place and feet are said to be of the nature of compassion.
The primal form is everywhere pervading, called the individual: Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah, Mahah, Janah, Tapah and Satya, sevenfold.
One should place the first on the hand and body in the order beginning with the thumb; the seventh, the lord of the worlds, resting on the palm, in the body in order.
In the body, abiding in head, forehead, mouth, heart, secret place and feet: Agnishtoma, Ukthya, Shodashi, Vajapeya,
Atiratra, Aptoryama — the sacrifice-self of seven forms. Intellect, I-sense, mind, sound, then touch, form and taste,
smell, intellect: the pervading one should be placed in hand and body in order. One should place on the last, on the palms, on head, forehead, mouth and heart,
navel, secret place and feet: the eightfold-array Person is remembered. Seed, intellect, ego, mind, sound, the quality air,
form, taste — this nine-natured individual on the two thumbs; the rest in order from the forefinger up to the left index finger.
In the body, head, forehead, face, heart, navel, secret place and knees, and on the feet: this ten-natured Indra, pervading, is established.
On the two thumbs fire, and on the forefingers and the others; on head, forehead, mouths, heart, navel, secret place and knees,
on the feet — the eleven-natured: mind, ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose, speech, hand, foot, anus,
generative organ; the mental pervader: ear on the two thumbs; eight in order from the forefinger; the remainder on the two palms;
on the best finger, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, then the secret place, the pair of thighs, likewise the shanks, and ankles and feet in order.
Vishnu, Madhusudana, Trivikrama and Vamana, Shridhara, then Hrishikesha and Padmanabha likewise,
Damodara, Keshava and Narayana, then another, Madhava and Govinda: one should place Vishnu as the pervader.
On the thumb and the rest, on the two palms, feet, knees and hips; on head, crest and hip, one should place on knees, feet and the rest.
The twelve-natured, the twenty-fifth, and the twenty-sixth array: the Person, intellect, ego, mind, thought, sound,
likewise touch, taste, form, smell, ear, skin, eye, tongue, nose, speech, hand, foot, anus,
generative organ, earth, water, fire, air and space. Having placed the pervading Person, one should place ten on the thumb and the rest;
placing the rest on the palm, then on head and forehead, mouth, heart, navel, secret place, thighs, knees and feet, arising from the organs;
on feet, knees, generative organ, heart and head in order. And the Supreme beyond the Person-self, in the twenty-sixth as before the supreme.
Having contemplated, the wise one should worship Prakriti in a single circle. In the east, south, west and north one should worship the heart-mantras and others.
The missile in the corners beginning with Agni's, Vainateya and the others as before; the guardians of the quarters, and another rule; in the three-fold array Agni in the middle.
Adorned with the lord of strength in the east and other directions, with ghee and so on; in the pericarp the sky one and the mental one stationed in the pericarp.
One should worship the universal form for the stability of all and for victory in the kingdom, joined with all arrays and with the five limbs,
with Garuda and others and Indra and others; one obtains all desires. One should worship Vishvaksena by name, the seed-syllable established in space.
Om Yam — causing the elements to fall; having taken, hear the joining with nature by this: "Om Yam, the elements, the Person" — I shall tell the oblation mantra, then the mantra of the full oblation.

Om, withdraw the elements, svaha. Om Am. Om, homage to the revered Vasudeva, vaushat. After the full oblation one should then accomplish that disciple. Thus the wise one should purify all the principles in order.

With one's own seed-syllable ending in "namah," preceded by striking and so on: "Om Vam — the organs of action; Om Dem — the organs of knowledge," with seed Yam, the application of striking and the rest in the same way.

Om Sum — in the subtle element of smell, disjoin, hum phat. Om Sampahi ha. Om Kham Kham Ksha — nature. Om Sum Hum — in the subtle element of smell, withdraw, svaha. Then the full oblation is applied thus in the following: "Om Ram — taste element. Om Bhem — form element. Om Ram — touch element. Om Em — sound element. Om Bham namah. Om Som — ego. Om Nam — intellect. Om Om — Prakriti." Thus the initiation-yoga for a single form is declared in brief; the same application is remembered for the nine-fold array and the rest.
Having burned, one should unite Prakriti and the person in the other, in nirvana; one should settle it in the changeless Lord, Prakriti and person.
Having purified the elements, one should purify the organs of action; then the elements called intellect, subtle elements, mind, knowledge and ego;
having purified the subtle body at the end, one should purify Prakriti again; the person, natural, pure, established in the Lord's abode,
having made all enjoyment within his range and a seat in liberation. Meditating, one should give the full oblation; this initiation is for the qualified.
Having worshipped with limbs and led the mantra's group of principles evenly, having purified in order at the end, endowed with all accomplishments,
meditating, one should give the full oblation; this initiation is remembered for the seeker, if there is not enough material or one's own power is lacking.
Having worshipped the god as before with all implements, and having dwelt upon it, on the twelfth day the best teacher should initiate.
A devoted, humble disciple endowed with all bodily qualities, who is not very wealthy, should be initiated after worship on a platform.
The whole path, divine, elemental and spiritual, by meditating in the order of creation in the disciple's body, the teacher
first satisfies in order with eight and eight oblations the creation; with their own mantras he should dismiss Vasudeva and the others, the progenitors and the rest.
Afterwards he should purify by oblation in the order of withdrawal; the teacher, having loosed the bonds tied to the womb, and the actions,
having drawn from the disciple's body, should purify the principles in order; having dissolved into the natural fire, into Vishnu, the presiding one,
he should accomplish the pure principle by the impure with the full oblation. When the disciple has reached Prakriti, having burned the natural qualities,
the teacher should either release or appoint the children to office. Or the teacher, abiding in feeling, may do the initiation of power for others.
For ascetics and the poor who have approached with devotion, having worshipped Vishnu on the platform and set the boy by his side,
the disciple facing the deity, himself standing with face slanting, meditating on the whole path divided by its own joints,
and likewise on the god in the disciple's body, the request regarding the presiding deity, contemplating by meditation-yoga, as before by striking and the rest,
one should purify all the principles in order on the platform in Hari; having disjoined by striking, having taken to the Self, intent,
having joined to the god, purified, having taken that by its nature, having brought it with pure feeling and joined it in order,
one should purify by meditation-yoga on all sides with the mudra of knowledge. When all principles are pure and the Lord is established in the primal,
having burned, he should quench the disciples and appoint them to the place of the Lord; or the best teacher should lead the seeker to the path of accomplishment.
In the same way the householder in office, tireless in action, should stay purifying himself until passion is destroyed.
Then, knowing the self as one whose passion is exhausted, with sins purified, the restrained one, having transferred the office to a son or disciple,
having burned the noose made of illusion, having renounced, established in his own Self, wishing the fall of the body, he should live with his mark unmanifest.
On the lotus of the wheel the lords of the months are to be worshipped in order. Eight primal ones, or six, or five, or four others.
For accomplishing the five-petalled one, having made the fish and thus the lotus, outside the lines of space the seat; there one should clean the compartments.
Then one should drop the dust on the drawn mandala; listen. The pericarp should be yellow; all lines white and even.
Three at the corners for the foot; two each in others; plastered in the four directions are the limbs.
In two cubits they should be thumb-sized, in one cubit half as much, white; the lotus with white, the junctions with black or dark.
Then one should erase two rows in the directions for the gateway; one should make four doors in the four quarters.
The filaments should be red and yellow; one should fill the corners with red; one should adorn the yoga seat as desired with all colors.
The wise one should make eight ornaments at the sides of the doors; the sub-ornaments at their sides are declared as many.
One should adorn the lane with creepers, canopies, leaves and the like; at the seat-door white; the ornament red; yellow.
Near the sub-ornaments the corners are declared; then in the four directions one should think two and two with the middle compartments.
The sub-ornament with blue and the corner conches with white; the filling in the auspicious is declared, and thus the filling in others.
One should erase four outside, one at each side; for the ornament three and three at the sides of the vanishing petal.
One should decorate the triangle with white and red and black; the two-cornered with red and yellow; the navel in the wheel with black.
Likewise in reverse one should make the sub-ornament afterward; one should think three inside and outside the corner, with two divisions.
